note: Windows NTS x64 builds of PHP extensions. Every URL was downloaded and its sha256 recorded.

extensions.name: Redis (phpredis)
extensions.description: Fast Redis client (Laravel / Symfony cache, sessions, queues).

extensions.name: APCu
extensions.description: In-memory user data cache shared between requests (apcu_fetch / apcu_store).

extensions.name: Imagick (ImageMagick)
extensions.description: Image processing with ImageMagick: resize, convert, thumbnails, PDF/SVG rendering.
extensions.note: Bundles ImageMagick: copy every CORE_RL_*/IM_MOD_RL_*/FILTER_* DLL next to php.exe. CORE_RL_MagickCore_.dll also needs vcomp140.dll (OpenMP runtime from the Visual C++ 2015-2022 x64 redistributable).

extensions.name: MongoDB
extensions.description: Official MongoDB driver (use with the mongodb/mongodb Composer library).
extensions.note: Links against the OpenSSL DLLs that ship with PHP itself (libssl/libcrypto in the PHP folder).

extensions.name: igbinary
extensions.description: Compact, fast binary replacement for the PHP serializer.

extensions.name: Memcached
extensions.description: Memcached client based on libmemcached (cache and sessions).
extensions.note: Built without igbinary/msgpack/zstd support (php and json serializers only).

extensions.name: XHProf
extensions.note: Set xhprof.output_dir in php.ini if you use the bundled UI to save runs.

extensions.name: SQL Server (sqlsrv)
extensions.note: Needs the Microsoft ODBC Driver 17 or 18 for SQL Server installed on Windows at runtime.

extensions.name: SQL Server (PDO)
extensions.description: PDO driver for Microsoft SQL Server (Laravel / Doctrine "sqlsrv" connections).
extensions.note: Needs the Microsoft ODBC Driver 17 or 18 for SQL Server installed on Windows at runtime.

extensions.name: YAML
extensions.description: YAML parser and emitter (yaml_parse / yaml_emit), libyaml built in.

extensions.name: php-ast
extensions.description: Exposes the PHP abstract syntax tree (used by Phan and other static analysers).

extensions.name: PCOV
extensions.description: Lightweight code coverage driver for PHPUnit (much faster than Xdebug coverage).
extensions.note: Coverage is collected only when pcov.enabled=1 (default); set pcov.directory if sources are not under the project root.

extensions.name: Mailparse
extensions.description: Parse and extract parts of RFC 822 / MIME e-mail messages.

extensions.name: SSH2
extensions.description: SSH, SFTP and SCP client functions (libssh2 bindings).
extensions.note: PHP 8.1+ builds load libssh2.dll from the PHP folder (it ships with PHP for curl); 7.4/8.0 builds are self-contained.

extensions.name: Zstandard
extensions.description: Zstandard compression functions (zstd_compress / zstd_uncompress) and output handler.

extensions.name: OAuth
extensions.note: Uses curl-related DLLs that ship with PHP (libssh2.dll, nghttp2.dll, libssl/libcrypto).
